Security

Codes, devices, and how a password sign-in is verified.

Stay signed in

How long this device stays signed in when the browser is closed, for example when your phone closes it in the background. Each visit restarts the period, up to 90 days after you signed in.

Not available yet.

Only choose a period on a device that is yours.

Devices kept signed in

Removing a device means it has to sign in again the next time its browser is closed. Changing your password or email address removes them all.

No devices are kept signed in.

    Connected apps

    Apps that can reach your mailbox. The ones you connected with a sign-in, and the access tokens you created by hand, are both listed here — each limited to the access you allowed. Revoking one stops it working immediately.

    No apps are connected yet. An app that offers a "Connect" or "Sign in" button appears here once you approve it.

      Access tokens

      For apps that ask you to paste a token. Each one is shown once when you create it. Changing your password or email address revokes them all.

      Read only can see your addresses and messages. Read and change can also create addresses and change settings.
      Creating access tokens requires a Pro account.
      Copy this access token now. It is shown this one time only — if you lose it, revoke it and create another.

      No access tokens yet.

        How to connect

        Add http://localhost:8085/mcp in your app and sign in when it asks — Claude.ai, a Claude Desktop custom connector and Claude Code all connect that way. Approve the request and the app appears above. Message content the app reads is sent to whoever runs it, so only connect a client you trust.

        For a client that only accepts a header, give it one of your access tokens instead:

        Claude Code

        claude mcp add --transport http mailshield http://localhost:8085/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"

        Claude Desktop — add to claude_desktop_config.json (needs Node.js)

        {
  "mcpServers": {
    "mailshield": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["mcp-remote", "http://localhost:8085/mcp", "--header", "Authorization: Bearer <token>"]
    }
  }
}

        Replace <token> with the token from the moment you created it.

        Two-factor authentication

        A code from your authenticator app, on top of your password.

        Loading status...

        Protects password sign-in with a code from your authenticator app. Email sign-in links already require access to your inbox and keep working as before.

        Lost your authenticator? You can always sign in with your email login link instead, then turn off two-factor authentication here.

        Two-factor authentication only takes effect once you have a password set — set one below to activate protection after enrolling.

        Scan with 1Password, Authy, Google Authenticator, or a similar app.

          Client Agent
          
                            
          Keys for the agent you run on your own mail server.
          

                            
          
                                
          Client signing keys
          
                                
          The agent verifies signed list-sync payloads against these keys. Rotate them if one may have leaked.
          
                                
                                
          Client signing keys require a Pro account.
          
                            
          
                        
          

                        
          
                            
          Delete account
          

                            
          
                                
          Permanently delete your account and all associated Pro settings. This cannot be undone.
